security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Train your own private AI and prove it got better
bundle.longDescription: Inkport trains small, private AI models on your own computer, checks them against a hidden exam before they are used, and serves them to your apps through a local OpenAI-compatible API. Everything needed is included in the installer and works offline.
